description: Pinned precision/recall benchmark for mcp-authscan. Each repo is frozen at a commit SHA so results are reproducible and survive upstream patching. Labels are human ground truth from the VATA corpus, independent of what the scanner currently detects: recall measures how much of that ground truth the detectors catch. Detector rules carry precision claims; review-list rules (A4/A5/B2, MEDIUM B1) enumerate surface and are never scored as false positives. Negatives are repos VATA audited and cleared. Coverage gaps are confirmed findings no current rule can catch - roadmap, not failures.

positives.name: lucky-aeon
positives.note: self-rolled AS: redirect_uri unvalidated (A1), hardcoded admin default re-seeded on boot (A2), authn-without-authz middleware (A3)

positives.name: webrix
positives.note: skipLocalPkceValidation:true with codeVerifier accepted and never used (B1); auth code never invalidated after redemption (B2)

positives.name: atrawog
positives.note: authorization code TTL ~1 year vs RFC6749 ~600s (B3); PKCE optional in practice

positives.name: akshay5995
positives.note: PKCE documented mandatory but never enforced; maps to B1 review variant / code-lifecycle surface

positives.name: mcpjungle
positives.note: DCR confused-deputy SSRF via self-declared RegistrationEndpoint (A4 review-list surface)

positives.name: docker-oauth-helpers
positives.note: PerformDCR POSTs to attacker-controlled RegistrationEndpoint via unguarded client (A4 review-list surface)

positives.name: metamcp
positives.note: admin error-state routes call unscoped findAll() while findAllAccessibleToUser exists - cross-tenant (CWE-863); covered by A7

positives.name: mcp-pinot
positives.note: EXTERNAL ground truth (GHSA-73cv, independent reporter, not VATA): FastMCP auth=None by default on http/0.0.0.0 - class A; caught by A10

negatives.name: agentic-community
negatives.note: OAuth-delegating, SSRF guard with DNS-rebind pinning, fail-closed throughout; no detector should fire

negatives.name: 1mcp-agent
negatives.note: fetch layer hardened; single-tenant admin session/CSRF correctly ordered; no detector should fire

negatives.name: ms-mcp-gateway
negatives.note: session-scoping, permission provider, agent tool authz, builtin sandboxing all clean; prior MSRC hardening; no detector should fire

negatives.name: ms-azure-devops
negatives.note: PAT fetch interceptor host allowlist; org is CLI arg not per-call; retracted FP guard - no detector should fire

latent.name: cuongdev
latent.note: X-Tenant header trusted with no membership check (isInOrg exists, never called) BUT no wired route passes header-derived tenantId into a vulnerable repo. A3 pattern present; human downgraded to latent. NOTE: benchmark also fired A2 on a dev-gated session secret - label call pending.

coverage_gaps.name: empires-unauth-dcr-scope
coverage_gaps.finding: unauthenticated DCR endpoint lets anonymous caller self-assign privileged scope
coverage_gaps.why_uncovered: no rule links unauth registration route to client-supplied scope grant
coverage_gaps.candidate_rule: A8: DCR/registration handler reads client-supplied scope/role with no auth guard on the route

coverage_gaps.name: unla-middleware-ordering
coverage_gaps.finding: AdminAuthMiddleware .Use() attached AFTER CreateTenant already registered - zero authz (CWE-862)
coverage_gaps.candidate_rule: A9: Gin/Echo RouterGroup.Use(auth) called after routes already registered on the same group
